0.content: Kusayla led Dakan Al-Ahmar, an Eremite brigade under the larger Deshret's Relics. He raised Dehya among his mercenaries. He was a slapdash, boastful man who put on plays and told hero stories for her, including the Legend of the Lion. Dehya came to see him as a criminal and left after a final argument. In Lionsblood (3.5) she learned that Deshret's Relics bound members with blackmail "records". Kusayla never let her be "recorded", lied and took beatings to protect her, and arranged her place with the Blazing Beasts and her job with the Homayanis. Years ago he went back to the Relics' headquarters and burned the records, dying in the fire and freeing his men.

1.comment: Dehya: Dunyarzad and the Homayani family
1.content: Dunyarzad Homayani, daughter of the merchant Shahzaman, was dying of Eleazar when Dehya was hired to guard her. Dehya caught her sneaking out to revive the Sabzeruz Festival. Respecting her determination, she let Dunyarzad "hire" her at half her father's rate to cover for her. She secretly sold her own claymore and donated the Mora to the festival, which is why she was still learning a new greatsword when kidnappers struck. After the sages fell and Eleazar was cured, Dehya quit as she had always planned, but they remain close. Dunyarzad throws her birthday parties and takes her dancing.

2.content: The Blazing Beasts are the Eremite band Dehya joined after leaving her father's brigade, and her chosen family. Kusayla secretly arranged for them to take her in so she could leave Dakan Al-Ahmar without harassment. They gave her the title Flame-Mane and sing campfire songs about "our precious Dehya". She is their most famous member but says she is not the boss, though their problems always end up on her plate. Her Vision helped her bring more fighters into the band.

3.content: Candace, the Guardian of Aaru Village, is one of Dehya's dearest friends. Dehya calls the village a safe haven. Her Eremites behave there when she brings them, which Candace appreciates, and Candace says Dehya looks like trouble but is "really quite adorable". Dehya keeps pushing her to rest, shop and wear the jewellery she gives her, with little success. During a limited-time 5.3 event she got Candace to come to Lantern Rite in Liyue, though only after the villagers insisted. The two often travel together on business.

4.content: In 3.0 the sages trapped Sumeru City in a repeating Sabzeruz Festival through the Akasha. Each loop, Dehya fought off mercenaries trying to kidnap Dunyarzad. The Traveler convinced her of the loop by knowing her secret about the sold greatsword. Though she could not see Nahida or the real Dunyarzad's spirit, she sensed Dunyarzad's aura. She then reasoned that the sages were using the Akasha to extract and pool people's minds into "a single, massive brain". Her own training dummy helped prove the city was a dream.
